[package]
name = "ironcalc_base"
version = "0.7.1"
authors = ["Nicolás Hatcher <nicolas@theuniverse.today>"]
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://www.ironcalc.com"
repository = "https://github.com/ironcalc/ironcalc/"
description = "Open source spreadsheet engine"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"

[features]
mock_time = []

[dependencies]
ryu = "1.0"
chrono = "0.4"
bitcode = "0.6.8"
csv = "1.3.0"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.statrs]
version = "0.18.0"
default-features = false
features = []

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.js-sys]
version = "0.3.69"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.wasm-bindgen]
version = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.regex-lite]
version = "0.1.6"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
rand = "0.8.5"
chrono-tz = "0.10"
regex = "1.0"

[package]
name = "rdocx"
description = "High-level API for reading, writing, and converting DOCX documents"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]
readme = "../../README.md"

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2"
regex = "1"

[dependencies.rdocx-opc]
path = "crates/rdocx-opc"
version = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.rdocx-oxml]
path = "crates/rdocx-oxml"
version = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.rdocx-layout]
path = "crates/rdocx-layout"
version = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.rdocx-pdf]
path = "crates/rdocx-pdf"
version = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.rdocx-html]
path = "crates/rdocx-html"
version = "0.1.2"

[dev-dependencies]

[package]
name = "rdocx-html"
description = "DOCX-to-HTML and DOCX-to-Markdown conversion"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[dependencies.rdocx-oxml]
path = "crates/rdocx-oxml"
version = "0.1.2"

[package]
name = "rdocx-layout"
description = "Layout engine for converting DOCX flow model to positioned frames"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[features]
bundled-fonts = []

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2"
fontdb = "0.23"
rustybuzz = "0.20"
ttf-parser = "0.25"
unicode-linebreak = "0.1"

[dependencies.rdocx-oxml]
path = "crates/rdocx-oxml"
version = "0.1.2"

[package]
name = "rdocx-opc"
description = "Open Packaging Convention (OPC) reader/writer for OOXML packages"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[dependencies]
zip = "8.1"
quick-xml = "0.37"
thiserror = "2"

[package]
name = "rdocx-oxml"
description = "WordprocessingML XML element types for OOXML"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[dependencies]
quick-xml = "0.37"
thiserror = "2"
itoa = "1"
regex = "1"

[package]
name = "rdocx-pdf"
description = "PDF renderer for rdocx layout output"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.93"
authors = ["Atul Sharma"]
repository = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
homepage = "https://github.com/tensorbee/rdocx"
keywords = ["docx", "word", "pdf", "ooxml", "document"]
categories = ["parser-implementations", "text-processing"]

[dependencies]
pdf-writer = "0.14"
subsetter = "0.2"
ttf-parser = "0.25"
miniz_oxide = "0.8"
tiny-skia = "0.11"

[dependencies.rdocx-layout]
path = "crates/rdocx-layout"
version = "0.1.2"

[source."vendored-sources"]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source."crates-io"]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/ironcalc/ironcalc"]
git = "https://github.com/ironcalc/ironcalc"
replace-with = "git-vendored-sources"
rev = "2f539370"

[source."https://github.com/hanthor/rdocx"]
git = "https://github.com/hanthor/rdocx"
replace-with = "git-vendored-sources"
rev = "3929421"

[source."git-vendored-sources"]
directory = "cargo/git-vendor"
